mentions.name: Dev workspace operating system
mentions.description: This project structures a development workspace like an operating system: 10 MCP servers act as device drivers for exchange APIs, browser automation, Apple docs, and issue tracking; 200+ skills serve as prose runbooks that compose system calls; agent-mail provides IPC between parallel agents; and a drift detector called "wobble" scores skill stability using bias/variance analysis.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building my dev workspace into an operating system. Not metaphorically — structurally.

  10 MCP servers as device drivers (exchange APIs, browser automation, Apple docs, issue tracking).
  200+ skills as prose runbooks that compose system calls. Agent-mail for IPC between parallel
  agents. A drift detector called "wobble" that scores skill stability using bias/variance analysis.
